subject: Renewal & expansion - recap and next steps (Nimbus Analytics)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aamir Khan <aamir.khan@nimbleanalytics.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Renewal/expansion call recap & next steps

Hi Aamir 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our renewal/expansion conversation and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Key facts / current usage
- Q2 average: ~12M generation tokens / month, with daily peak bursts up to ~10k requests/day.
- Current plan: Hosted API, standard throughput, no dedicated capacity.

Primary pain points you called out
- Latency spikes during peak windows for real-time summarization workflows.
- Cost unpredictability for batch embedding jobs (search re-indexes).
- Model quality drift on doc summarization for non-English content.

New workloads discussed
- Real-time summarization for support tickets (low latency SLO).
- Periodic bulk embeddings for search and recommendation (throughput-focused).
- Pilot for fine-tuning a summarization model (small eval set).

Proposed expansion path (recommended)
1) Pilot Dedicated capacity for the real-time summarization workload (1-month pilot, 3x A100-equivalent GPU pool) 
reduces latency variance and gives predictable throughput.
2) Add Redwood Optimize (quantization + batching guidance) for embedding and generation cost savings.
3) Run a small fine-tune / eval for the summarization model if initial latency/quality targets look good.

Ballpark economics (for planning only)
- Dedicated pilot (1 month): ~$18,000/mo (pro-rated for pilot)
- Redwood Optimize & support add-on: ~$2,000/mo
- Fine-tune eval band: one-time advisory ~ $4,500

Timeline 
- Pilot start: target week of Aug 3 (we can shift by a week if you need procurement time).
- Target renewal + expansion decision: by mid-September (you mentioned Sept 15 as a goal).

Next steps / asks
- Please confirm that the pilot timeline (week of Aug 3) works for you and if you have any procurement constraints.
- I've attached a brief usage extract (usage_report_Q2.csv) for our internal proposal.
- Aamir, can you confirm SOC 2 / VPC requirements so we include the right security options in the proposal?

Thanks 
I'll prepare a formal proposal once I have your confirmation on timeline and security constraints.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Attachment: usage_report_Q2.csv (CSV, 42KB)

From: Aamir Khan <aamir.khan@nimbleanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Renewal/expansion call recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa 

Good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Timeline: procurement is on a two-week turnaround once we have a formal quote. Our target renewal date remains Sept 15, so the Aug pilot timing should work but we need a signed pilot SOW by end of July to hit that.
- Security: we need SOC 2 Type II evidence and VPC peering (or Private deployment options) documented in the proposal 
security is a blocker for our procurement.
- SLOs: our SLA for the summarization endpoint needs a P90 latency <= 250ms during peak windows; happy to share p95/p99 traces if helpful.

Please include an explicit line item for the pilot SOW and any proposed discount for a pilot that converts to committed Dedicated capacity. Also send over an initial pricing PDF I can share with our finance team.

Appreciate it 
Aamir
